meta.description: Pinned MemGQL archive-lane expectations against the deterministic devkit fixture (StarRocks-backed archive_topology). Authored empirically 2026-07-06 on memgraph/memgql:0.7.0. Key finding: bounded quantified paths {m,n} FAIL on StarRocks (MemGQL emits WITH RECURSIVE, which StarRocks does not support — memgraph/memgraph#4178 dialect gap), and the inner-WHERE group form silently drops both the anchor and the predicate (SQL-backend variant of #4343/#4345). Fixed-hop fan-out batches remain the only correct archive traversal form. Rows with upstream_issue are canaries: an image bump that changes an outcome fails tests/capability-matrix expectations loudly.
meta.anchor_note: fixture identity with exactly 1 direct outflow; re-derive counts when the devkit fixture is regenerated
